Manifest.Name: 要不要进货 Inventory Category Stats
Manifest.Author: Oniisama
Manifest.Description:
在柜台电话下沿贴一张便签。点开后按游戏标签做物品分类统计：每行一个品类、颜色和件数，并记下赃物与违禁品。悬停高亮对应库存，点击锁定后不再跟着别的标签变。用来看品类记录和标签记录，决定要不要进货。
便签右上角的扳手打开游戏内设置，改完立刻生效。
基础 - 跳过上锁容器里的货（默认开启） - 跳过杂物堆（默认开启） - 排除项仍计入赃物和违禁品（默认开启） - 描边粗细：1 到 6，默认最细 - 库存刷新间隔：0.2 到 2 秒，默认 0.4 秒
显示类型 赃物、违禁品和基础类型默认显示。 细分类型和未归类默认不显示。 勾选的类型都会出现在便签上，没有库存也显示 0。
排除标签 勾选的细分标签整件不计入品类，也不描边。
排除物品 可搜索并勾选，默认都不排除。
被排除的货默认仍计入全部赃物和全部违禁品，悬停这两行时也会描边。
A sticky note sits under the counter phone. Open it for a tally by the game's own tags: each row shows a category, its color, and a count, and stolen goods and contraband are noted too. Hover a row to outline that stock; click to lock the highlight so it stays put when you look at another tag. Use it to read the category and tag records and decide whether to restock.
The wrench at the top right of the note opens the in-game settings. Changes apply immediately.
General - Skip goods inside locked containers (on by default) - Skip debris (on by default) - Still count excluded goods as stolen and contraband (on by default) - Outline thickness: 1 to 6, thinnest by default - Stock refresh interval: 0.2 to 2 seconds, 0.4 by default
Show types Stolen goods, contraband, and the main types are shown by default. Detail types and Uncategorized stay off. Every checked type appears on the note, including a count of 0.
Exclude tags A checked detail tag drops the whole item from category rows and outlines.
Exclude items Search and check items. Nothing is excluded by default.
Excluded goods still count toward All stolen and All contraband by default, and they outline when those rows are hovered.
